item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently expands the national emergency and blocks covered property by operation of the order once Treasury identifies a qualifying person; the legal consequence is the property restraint itself, not a later agency-imposed outcome.","evidence":"all property and interests in property that are in the United States, that hereafter come within the United States, or that are or hereafter come within the possession or control of United States persons, including their overseas branches, of the following persons are blocked"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory determination that covered donations would seriously impair his response to the emergency; this determination has immediate legal significance and supports the accompanying prohibition.","evidence":"I hereby determine that the making of donations of the type of articles specified in section 203(b)(2) of IEEPA"},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President directly prohibits covered donations, evasive transactions, and conspiracies; those legal restrictions arise from the segment itself.","evidence":"Any transaction by a United States person or within the United States that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, or attempts to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited."},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President makes a supporting factual finding about the practical effect of prior notice, but this segment alone neither removes notice nor otherwise changes legal rights; that consequence occurs in the next segment.","evidence":"prior notice to such persons of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would render these measures ineffectual."},{"segment_id":"5","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines that listings and determinations under section 1 require no prior notice, immediately altering the affected persons' procedural entitlement.","evidence":"there need be no prior notice of a listing or determination made pursuant to section 1 of this order."},{"segment_id":"6","code":0,"rationale":"This is only a section heading and identifies no actor, action, object, or legal consequence.","evidence":"Sec. 5."},{"segment_id":"7","code":1,"rationale":"The President authorizes Treasury to implement the order, issue rules as necessary, exercise delegated powers, and redelegate functions without dictating a particular later legal outcome.","evidence":"The Secretary of the Treasury may redelegate any of these functions to other officers and agencies of the United States Government consistent with applicable law."},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs agencies to undertake appropriate implementation within existing authority, leaving the particular measures and any later consequences to agency discretion.","evidence":"All agencies of the United States Government are hereby directed to take all appropriate measures within their authority to carry out the provisions of this order."},{"segment_id":"9","code":0,"rationale":"The segment authorizes reports to Congress and disclaims creation of enforceable private rights; it does not direct an agency to impose, or itself confer, a substantive legal entitlement.","evidence":"This order is not intended to, and does not, create any right or benefit, substantive or procedural, enforceable at law or in equity by any party"}]}
